title: DICOM viewers for radiographers and radiologists
why: Outside the hospital PACS, a desktop viewer lets you review teaching files, prepare presentations and learn anatomy across modalities.
what_is_different: Imaging work requires strict de-identification, correct window/level presets per modality, and never using non-certified viewers for primary diagnosis unless approved by your institution.

extra_modules.title: De-identification and governance
extra_modules.practice: Anonymise a sample study and confirm the tags are removed

starter_project: Build a de-identified teaching file of ten cases with measurements and 3D reconstructions for a teaching session.
pitfalls: Patient identifiers left in DICOM tags or file names
Wrong window settings leading to missed findings

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
